tuning_key.text: How we're going to make it to the next stage of this journey through the cosmos all together
tuning_key.attribution: Chords of Truth — Lucid Principles Canon (CC BY 4.0)

context_block: The next threshold doesn't require perfection—it requires us. Joy arrives when you stop calculating the path alone and feel the irregular brightness of moving together, still held, still drifting forward.

practice.title: Locate the Irregular
practice.instruction: Notice one moment today where something unexpected made you smile—a sound, a word, a small collision of timing—and let it land without explanation.

practice.title: Feel the Drift
practice.instruction: Sit or stand still for one breath and sense the exact point where you're held and where you're moving at the same time, without choosing between them.

practice.title: Play the Echo
practice.instruction: Press play on the audio and let the laughter and signal move through you as permission to move forward with others, not as certainty, but as companionship.
